item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ana Paula Pereira

item.title: US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions
item.description: The US Treasury bureau FinCEN on Friday ordered US financial institutions to stop processing transfers involving MEXC Global.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details, personal data and crypto wallet information
item.description: The crypto debit card provider said customer funds remained safe despite the exposure of sensitive financial and personal information.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Binance hack is ‘cyber war,’ TRM Labs executive says
item.description: TRM Labs executive Ari Redbord called for governments to take offensive action against North Korean hackers following the record $6.3 billion Binance theft.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

media:content.caption: ari redborn trm labs in front of a background with the word hacked
media:content.media:description: ari redborn trm labs in front of a background with the word hacked

item.title: US 401(k) proposal leaves door open to altcoins, but hurdles remain
item.description: While the proposal doesn’t exclude altcoins and smaller cryptocurrencies, experts say they could face challenges getting into retirement plans.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Russia finalizes crypto trading rules ahead of Nov. 17 rollout
item.description: The rules allow retail investors to trade BTC, ETH and USDT through regulated intermediaries, with Moscow Exchange planning to launch crypto trading in December.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Strive buys 15,124 Bitcoin in October, closes in on top treasury holders
item.description: Bitcoin treasury company Strive reported $509 million in third-quarter net income and purchased 15,124 BTC in October, bringing its total holdings to 43,124 BTC.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin price dips under $75K as crypto markets miss tech-stock rebound
item.description: BTC price action stayed weak after US nonfarm payrolls data significantly beat forecasts, increasing bets of a December interest-rate hike.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act
item.description: The CLARITY Act faces a new test as Democrats control Congress, raising questions over consumer protections, ethics and what the crypto industry may have to concede.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
item.description: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Ethereum devs won’t fork Glamsterdam on Hoodi until smart contract risks resolved
item.description: Ethereum developers are investigating concerns tied to eight smart contract invariants tied to Glamsterdam’s EIP-8037 and EIP-8038.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report
item.description: Solana’s promotional campaigns through domestic entities allegedly violated China’s crypto-related restrictions, an unidentified PBOC official told China’s Financial News.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Binance hackers had 8-week intrusion window before $6.3B exploit: SEAL
item.description: The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin holds $75K as AI regulation fears see KOSPI halted after 8% crash
item.description: Bitcoin consolidated as fears over US AI regulation spread to Asia, causing South Korea to announce measures to calm stock-market volatility.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains starting in 2027
item.description: Greece has approved a 10% tax on cryptocurrency gains starting in 2027, with an exemption for investors whose annual net gains do not exceed 500 euros.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: GOPAX halts crypto trading, withdrawals to move all assets to cold storage
item.description: South Korea’s GOPAX suspended trading, deposits and standard withdrawals after a hacking threat, with manual withdrawals available through support.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Binance’s $6.3B hack leaves questions over hot wallet safeguards
item.description: Experts say blockchain records show repeated wallet drains but cannot establish Binance’s internal signing controls or transaction limits.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool
item.description: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade has rendered about $15 million in legacy Sprout funds unspendable, although a future network upgrade could potentially restore access.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps
item.description: The HYPE treasury company spent $785 million on tokens during the quarter and wants to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate
item.description: US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs shed a combined $530 million Thursday as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US stocks tumbled.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed password hashes and live tokens
item.description: Chainalysis disclosed password hashes and live tokens were exposed after initially reporting only non-sensitive customer data was accessed.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Crypto exchanges tout cold storage ratios after Binance attack
item.description: Coinbase says it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline, while Gate reports 88.26% of its total assets are kept in cold storage.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
item.description: The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI
item.description: The Eric Trump-backed miner reported $126 million in quarterly net income, largely driven by gains on its Bitcoin holdings, despite rising mining costs and shrinking margins.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
item.description: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair
item.description: Republican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
item.description: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
item.description: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
item.description: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
item.description: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar
